CONSTRUCTION LOAN AGREEMENT
Dated: As of July 1, 2023
SUMMIT RIDGE DEVELOPMENT PARTNERS, LP
("Borrower")
and
CORNERSTONE BANCORP
("Lender")
$22,500,000.00 CONSTRUCTION LOAN
For construction of a 120-unit multifamily residential complex
located at 7800 Crestview Boulevard, Austin, Texas 78701
ARTICLE I — DEFINITIONS
"Approved Budget" means the itemized construction budget attached as Exhibit B, as amended with Lender's
approval.
"Approved Plans" means the construction drawings, specifications and plans approved by Lender in writing
prior to the Closing Date.
"Architect" means Crestview Design Studio, LLC, or another architect approved by Lender.
"Completion Date" means December 31, 2024, as may be extended by Lender in writing.
"Construction Contract" means the general contract between Borrower and General Contractor for
construction of the Improvements.
"Contingency Reserve" means a minimum 5% contingency line item within the Approved Budget.
"Draw Request" means Borrower's written requisition for a disbursement of Loan proceeds in the form
attached as Exhibit C.
"General Contractor" means Apex Building Corporation, licensed in Texas, or another contractor approved by
Lender.
"Guarantor" means Michael R. Summit and Ridge Capital Partners Fund II, LLC, jointly and severally.
"Improvements" means the 120-unit multifamily residential complex to be constructed on the Property.
"Inspection Fee" means $1,500 per construction inspection performed by Lender's Inspector.
"Inspector" means a licensed engineer or construction specialist retained by Lender at Borrower's expense.
"Interest Reserve" means $1,350,000 set aside within the Loan proceeds to pay interest during the
construction period.
"Lien Waiver" means a conditional or unconditional release of mechanic's lien rights executed by the General
Contractor and all subcontractors and materialmen as a condition to each Draw.
"Loan Conversion" means the conversion of the construction loan to a permanent term loan as described in
Section 3.6.
"Maturity Date" means the earlier of (i) June 30, 2025 or (ii) the Completion Date plus 90 days.
"Property" means the real property at 7800 Crestview Boulevard, Austin, Texas 78701, described in Exhibit A.

"Retainage" means 10% of each progress payment withheld from the General Contractor until Substantial
Completion.
"Substantial Completion" means completion of Improvements such that a Certificate of Occupancy has been
issued and all units are available for occupancy.
ARTICLE II — CONDITIONS PRECEDENT TO CLOSING
The obligation of Lender to close the Loan is conditioned upon:
(a) Executed Loan Documents, including this Agreement, Construction Note, Deed of Trust, Assignment of
Leases and Rents, and Guaranty.
(b) Title insurance commitment insuring Lender's Deed of Trust as a first lien, with no exceptions other than
Permitted Encumbrances.
(c) Approved Plans and Approved Budget in form satisfactory to Lender and Inspector.
(d) Executed Construction Contract and all major subcontracts for amounts exceeding $250,000.
(e) Evidence of all required building permits and governmental approvals for construction.
(f) ALTA survey of the Property acceptable to Lender.
(g) Environmental Phase I (and Phase II if required) satisfactory to Lender.
(h) Evidence of builder's risk, general liability and workers' compensation insurance.
(i) Appraisal showing as-completed value with Loan-to-Value not exceeding 65%.
(j) Evidence of equity contribution: Borrower shall have contributed not less than $8,500,000 of equity prior to
or concurrently with the initial Loan disbursement.
ARTICLE III — LOAN TERMS AND DISBURSEMENTS
Section 3.1 The Loan. Subject to the conditions herein, Lender agrees to make a construction loan in the principal
amount not to exceed $22,500,000.00. The Loan is a single-advance facility; amounts repaid may not be
reborrowed.
Section 3.2 Interest Rate. The Loan shall bear interest at Term SOFR (1-month) plus 2.50%, with a floor of 4.00%
per annum. After any Event of Default, interest accrues at the Default Rate (Interest Rate + 5%). Interest is
computed on a 360-day year.
Section 3.3 Draw Procedure. Borrower may request disbursements no more than once per month by submitting a
Draw Request at least 10 Business Days prior to the requested disbursement date. Each Draw Request must
include: (i) a completed draw schedule by budget line item; (ii) unconditional Lien Waivers for all prior payments;
(iii) conditional Lien Waivers for the current draw; (iv) updated schedule of values; (v) Inspector's approval; and (vi)
Architect's certificate of percentage complete.
Section 3.4 Conditions to Each Disbursement. Each disbursement is conditioned on: (a) no Event of Default; (b)
Inspector's confirmation that work is in place and conforms to Approved Plans; (c) Lien Waivers as described
above; (d) title endorsement bringing the Lender's lien current; (e) budget balance sufficient to complete remaining
work.
Section 3.5 Interest Reserve. Lender shall establish an Interest Reserve of $1,350,000 from the Loan proceeds.
Monthly interest payments shall be disbursed from the Interest Reserve until exhausted, after which Borrower shall
pay interest directly.
Section 3.6 Conversion Option. Upon Substantial Completion and satisfaction of Lender's conversion conditions
(including minimum occupancy of 85% and DSCR of 1.20:1.00), Borrower may request conversion of the

outstanding Loan balance to a 5-year term loan at Term SOFR plus 2.00% with 25-year amortization. Lender's
commitment to convert is subject to Lender's credit approval at the time of conversion.
Section 3.7 Maturity and Repayment. All outstanding principal, accrued interest and other Obligations are due
and payable on the Maturity Date. No amortization payments are required during the construction period.
Section 3.8 Fees. (a) Origination Fee: 1.00% of Commitment ($225,000), due at closing. (b) Extension Fee: 0.50%
of outstanding balance per 90-day extension, if any. (c) Inspection Fees: As incurred.
ARTICLE IV — CONSTRUCTION COVENANTS
Section 4.1 Construction Obligations. Borrower shall: (a) commence construction within 30 days of the Closing
Date; (b) prosecute construction diligently and continuously; (c) complete construction by the Completion Date; (d)
comply with all applicable Legal Requirements; (e) not make material changes to the Approved Plans without
Lender's prior written approval.
Section 4.2 Cost Overruns. If Lender determines at any time that Loan proceeds are or may be insufficient to
complete construction per the Approved Budget, Borrower shall, within 10 Business Days of demand, deposit with
Lender cash in an amount equal to the projected shortfall.
Section 4.3 Casualty During Construction. In the event of any casualty to the Improvements, Borrower shall
immediately notify Lender. Insurance proceeds shall be held by Lender and disbursed for restoration subject to
Lender's approval.
Section 4.4 Inspections. Lender and its Inspector shall have the right to inspect the Property and construction at
any time upon reasonable notice. Borrower shall cooperate with and provide access to Lender's Inspector.
Section 4.5 Change Orders. Change orders in excess of $50,000 individually or $250,000 cumulatively require
Lender's prior written consent and Approved Budget amendment.
ARTICLE V — REPRESENTATIONS, WARRANTIES AND GENERAL COVENANTS
Section 5.1 Representations. Borrower represents that: (a) it is validly organized and authorized to enter into the
Loan Documents; (b) all financial statements are accurate; (c) it has obtained all required governmental approvals;
(d) the Property is not subject to any Lien other than Permitted Encumbrances; (e) no litigation exists that could
have a Material Adverse Effect.
Section 5.2 Financial Reporting. Borrower shall provide Lender with: (a) monthly construction progress reports
within 15 days of month-end; (b) annual financial statements within 90 days of fiscal year-end; (c) Guarantor's
personal financial statements annually within 90 days of year-end; (d) leasing status reports (once Loan
Conversion conditions are being pursued) monthly.
Section 5.3 Prohibitions. Without Lender's prior written consent, Borrower shall not: (a) encumber or transfer the
Property; (b) incur additional debt; (c) change the General Contractor or Architect; (d) commence leasing on terms
not previously approved by Lender.
ARTICLE VI — EVENTS OF DEFAULT AND REMEDIES
Events of Default include: (a) failure to pay any amount due within 5 days; (b) abandonment of construction for
more than 15 days; (c) failure to achieve Substantial Completion by the Completion Date; (d) any representation
proves materially false; (e) bankruptcy or insolvency of Borrower or Guarantor; (f) any mechanic's lien filed and not
discharged within 30 days; (g) loss or expiration of building permits. Upon an Event of Default, Lender may: (i)
declare all Obligations immediately due; (ii) terminate further disbursements; (iii) take possession of and complete

construction at Borrower's expense; (iv) foreclose on the Deed of Trust.
ARTICLE VII — GENERAL PROVISIONS
Governing Law: Texas. Venue: Travis County, Texas. Jury Trial Waiver: Each party waives the right to trial by
jury. Amendments: Must be in writing, signed by both parties. Notices: Borrower: 200 Congress Avenue, Suite
400, Austin, TX 78701; Lender: 1200 Commerce Street, Dallas, TX 75202. Indemnity: Borrower indemnifies
Lender against all losses arising from the Loan, construction or the Property, except losses caused by Lender's
gross negligence or willful misconduct.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first set forth above.
SUMMIT RIDGE DEVELOPMENT PARTNERS, LP CORNERSTONE BANCORP
a Texas limited partnership a Texas state-chartered bank

Name: _________________________ Name: _________________________
Title: __________________________ Title: __________________________

**Executive Summary: Construction Loan Agreement with Summit Ridge Development Partners, LP**

**Transaction Overview**

Cornerstone Bancorp (Lender) has entered into a Construction Loan Agreement with Summit Ridge Development Partners, LP (Borrower) dated July 1, 2023. The loan is for $22,500,000.00 to finance the construction of a 120-unit multifamily residential complex located at 7800 Crestview Boulevard, Austin, Texas 78701. The loan matures on June 30, 2025.

**Parties and Roles**

* Borrower: Summit Ridge Development Partners, LP
* Lender: Cornerstone Bancorp
* Guarantor: Michael R. Summit and Ridge Capital Partners Fund II, LLC
* General Contractor: Apex Building Corporation
* Architect: Crestview Design Studio, LLC

**Financial Terms**

* Loan Amount: $22,500,000.00
* Interest Rate: Term SOFR (1-month) plus 2.50%, with a floor of 4.00% per annum
* Interest Reserve: $1,350,000
* Origination Fee: 1.00% of Commitment ($225,000)
* Extension Fee: 0.50% of outstanding balance per 90-day extension

**Collateral and Security**

* The loan is secured by a Deed of Trust on the property located at 7800 Crestview Boulevard, Austin, Texas 78701.
* The property is described in Exhibit A to the agreement.

**Key Covenants**

* The Borrower must maintain a minimum contingency reserve of 5% within the approved budget.
* The Borrower must withhold 10% retainage from the General Contractor until substantial completion.
* The Borrower must provide lien waivers for all prior payments and conditional lien waivers for the current draw.

**Events of Default**

* Events of default are not explicitly detailed in this summary, but are referenced in the agreement.

**Governing Law and Jurisdiction**

* Not explicitly stated in the provided document.

**Notable Provisions**

* The loan has a conversion option to a 5-year term loan at Term SOFR plus 2.00% with 25-year amortization, subject to lender's credit approval.
* The loan has a completion date of December 31, 2024, which may be extended by the Lender in writing.
* The Borrower is required to contribute not less than $8,500,000 of equity prior to or concurrently with the initial loan disbursement.

**1. Transaction Overview**

The Construction Loan Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on July 1, 2023, between Summit Ridge Development Partners, LP ("Borrower") and Cornerstone Bancorp ("Lender"). The loan is for $22,500,000.00 to finance the construction of a 120-unit multifamily residential complex located at 7800 Crestview Boulevard, Austin, Texas 78701.

**2. Parties and Roles**

* **Borrower:** Summit Ridge Development Partners, LP, a Texas limited partnership, responsible for constructing the multifamily residential complex.
* **Lender:** Cornerstone Bancorp, a Texas state-chartered bank, providing the construction loan.
* **Guarantor:** Michael R. Summit and Ridge Capital Partners Fund II, LLC, jointly and severally, guaranteeing the loan.
* **General Contractor:** Apex Building Corporation, licensed in Texas, responsible for construction.
* **Architect:** Crestview Design Studio, LLC, responsible for designing the project.

**3. Financial Terms**

* **Loan Amount:** $22,500,000.00
* **Interest Rate:** Term SOFR (1-month) plus 2.50%, with a floor of 4.00% per annum. After an Event of Default, interest accrues at the Default Rate (Interest Rate + 5%).
* **Interest Reserve:** $1,350,000 set aside from the loan proceeds to pay interest during the construction period.
* **Fees:**
	+ Origination Fee: 1.00% of the commitment ($225,000), due at closing.
	+ Extension Fee: 0.50% of the outstanding balance per 90-day extension, if any.
	+ Inspection Fees: $1,500 per construction inspection performed by Lender's Inspector.
* **Maturity Date:** The earlier of (i) June 30, 2025, or (ii) the Completion Date plus 90 days.

**4. Collateral and Security**

* **Property:** The real property located at 7800 Crestview Boulevard, Austin, Texas 78701, described in Exhibit A.
* **Deed of Trust:** A deed of trust will be executed to secure the loan, which will be a first lien on the property.
* **Lien Waivers:** Conditional or unconditional releases of mechanic's lien rights will be executed by the General Contractor and all subcontractors and materialmen as a condition to each draw.

**5. Key Covenants**

* **Construction Covenants:**
	+ Borrower shall commence construction within 30 days of the Closing Date.
	+ Borrower shall prosecute construction diligently and continuously.
	+ Borrower shall complete construction by the Completion Date (December 31, 2024).
* **Financial Covenants:**
	+ Borrower shall provide monthly construction progress reports within 15 days of month-end.
	+ Borrower shall provide annual financial statements within 90 days of fiscal year-end.
* **Other Covenants:**
	+ Borrower shall not encumber or transfer the Property without Lender's prior written consent.
	+ Borrower shall not incur additional debt without Lender's prior written consent.

**6. Events of Default**

* **Events of Default:** Include, but are not limited to:
	+ Failure to pay any amount due within 5 days.
	+ Abandonment of construction for more than 15 days.
	+ Failure to achieve Substantial Completion by the Completion Date.
	+ Any representation proves materially false.
	+ Bankruptcy or insolvency of Borrower or Guarantor.
* **Remedies:** Upon an Event of Default, Lender may:
	+ Declare all Obligations immediately due.
	+ Terminate further disbursements.
	+ Take possession of and complete construction at Borrower's expense.
	+ Foreclose on the Deed of Trust.

**7. Governing Law and Jurisdiction**

* **Governing Law:** The Agreement will be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Texas.
* **Venue:** Any disputes arising from the Agreement will be resolved in Travis County, Texas.
* **Jury Trial Waiver:** Each party waives the right to trial by jury.

**8. Notable Provisions**

* **Conversion Option:** Upon Substantial Completion and satisfaction of Lender's conversion conditions, Borrower may request conversion of the outstanding Loan balance to a 5-year term loan at Term SOFR plus 2.00% with 25-year amortization.
* **Retainage:** 10% of each progress payment will be withheld from the General Contractor until Substantial Completion.
* **Change Orders:** Change orders in excess of $50,000 individually or $250,000 cumulatively require Lender's prior written consent and Approved Budget amendment.

raw_llm_narrative:
The construction loan agreement between Summit Ridge Development Partners, LP (the Borrower) and Cornerstone Bancorp (the Lender) is for a $22.5 million loan to finance the construction of a 120-unit multifamily residential complex in Austin, Texas. The loan terms indicate a relatively standard construction loan setup, with an interest rate tied to Term SOFR (1-month) plus 2.50%, with a floor of 4.00% per annum. However, I note that the interest rate can increase by 5% upon an Event of Default, which may be considered aggressive.

The loan agreement outlines several conditions precedent to closing, including the requirement for an appraisal showing an as-completed value with a Loan-to-Value not exceeding 65%. This relatively conservative LTV ratio is a positive aspect, suggesting that the lender is taking a cautious approach to the loan. However, I also note that the Borrower is required to contribute a significant equity amount of $8.5 million prior to or concurrently with the initial loan disbursement. This substantial equity contribution may mitigate some of the risk, but it also highlights the Borrower's significant financial commitment to the project.

A few aspects of the loan agreement raise concerns or are worth highlighting. The loan has a conversion option to a 5-year term loan at Term SOFR plus 2.00% with 25-year amortization, subject to the lender's credit approval at the time of conversion. This conversion option may introduce some uncertainty, as the lender's credit approval process may be subjective. Additionally, I note that the loan agreement does not explicitly mention a clause for potential changes in the construction timeline or budget. Given the complexity of construction projects, this lack of specificity may increase the risk of disputes or disagreements between the borrower and lender.

The loan agreement also outlines a detailed draw procedure and conditions for each disbursement, which seems comprehensive. However, I would expect to see a more detailed description of the lender's inspection and approval process for each draw. The agreement mentions an Inspection Fee of $1,500 per construction inspection performed by the Lender's Inspector, but it would be beneficial to have more clarity on the frequency and scope of these inspections. Furthermore, I note that the Guarantor, Michael R. Summit and Ridge Capital Partners Fund II, LLC, is jointly and severally liable for the loan. This unlimited liability for the guarantor may be a concern, particularly if the guarantor's financial situation changes during the loan term.

Lastly, I observe that the loan agreement does not contain a standard clause for potential environmental or construction-related risks. While the agreement mentions an Environmental Phase I (and Phase II if required) satisfactory to the Lender, it would be beneficial to have more explicit language addressing potential risks and liabilities associated with the construction project. Overall, while the loan agreement appears to be well-structured, these observations highlight some potential areas of concern that warrant further review and consideration.
